title: Mission 226 In Liberia!
segments: [singing]
>> From the red clay soil, our roots run
deep. A promise our ancestors died to
keep.  Through the fire and the
flood, we held our ground and the voice
of our calling rings out loud. Rise up,
Liberia, the time is now.
>> We carried the burden and we kept the
faith.
>> Blood of the 12 tribes flows through our
veins. No more silent suffering. No more
chains.  Rise up, rise up. Let
the whole world know. From the seed of
our fathers, watch us grow.
Two wars tore through  us. 14
years lost. A generation silenced. We
know the cost. The schools went quiet.
The children cried, but the spirit of
our people  never died. Now the
gospel is rising on Liberian ground.
What the enemy buried, the truth
has found. From Monrovia's streets to
the palm tree lines. The word is
spreading  like the morning sun.
The 12 tribes scattered now finding
their way back to the light of an
ancient  day.
>> [singing]
>> No more darkness. No more delay.
Liberia, your moment is today.
>> We were silenced by the guns in the
years of pain, but you can't stop a
people from rising again. Our classrooms
may have closed, but the truth stayed
alive. Now we carry the gospel so our
children can thrive.
Rise up,
>> Liberia, the time is now. We carried the
burden and we kept the faith. Blood of
the 12 tribes flows through our veins.
No more silent suffering. No more
chains.  Rise up, rise up. Let
the whole world feel. The power of the
people that history couldn't kill.
Truth is here now.
Let Liberia be healed.
Allowing our resources and everything to
be stripped from us and thinking that
we're giving it away to Jesus
when you don't even recognize that you
yourself are descendants of Jesus. We
prayed for the Lord to increase our
faith. When your faith gets increased,
>> you believe in what you're saying and
what you do. So that that's the
motivation for you. That pushes you.
